main_text.p: tem nobis fuere de regionibus illis, non despero futurum, ut hoc meo opusculo aliquantulum illustrentur, sed certe multo magis epistolis meis, si unquam prodierint vernacula lingua, ad amicum quondam conscriptis, in quibus universae peregrinationis meae narratio diffuse continetur.

Has ut publico conceedam, eadem me remorantur difficultates, & insuper non parum laboris ac temporis, quod in illis rescribendis expoliendisque, operae pretium foret insumere. Nihil aliud reliquum est, Vir doctissime, nisi ut te rogem, curiosae cuidam exercitationi meae satisfaciendi gratia, ut ad me, cum primum rescripseris, mittas Hebraico inprimis sermone, mox & Samarita-no atque unoquoque eorum propriis u-triusque Linguae Characteribus, separa-tim, correctequae[?] scripta, eademque Latinis etiam literis, ut sonus vocalium cuiuslibet dictionis melius à me percipi possit, verba illa, quae ab ecclesia Catholica in signo sanctae crucis, necnon in Ba-ptismate, recitari solent, videlicet, In

page.notes: Show-through and grey shadows along the right edge are not printed text and are omitted. "conceedam" appears as printed. "correctequae" is a doubtful reading. The Latin characters are as printed, except that u/v is normalised to the vowel/consonant form. "Samarita-no" and "Hebrai-co" are hyphenated at line ends as printed. The page ends mid-sentence with "In" and continues with "no-" in the catchword.
